title: Sugreeva's narration of the abduction
introduction: After befriending Rama Sugreeva promises him to bring back Seetha from whatever place she is held captive. He informs that he has seen Seetha travelling overhead in the sky while being abducted. He also says that the lady while being abducted has dropped her ornaments wrapping in her upper cloth at their place atop the mountain. Then Sugreeva shows the ornaments to Rama asking him to identify them. Rama recognises the ornaments and the upper cloth of Seetha, and angered at the scandalous act of abduction he avows to eradicate that demon along with his clansmen.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे षष्टः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 6th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
पुनरेव अब्रवीत् प्रीतः राघवम् रघुनन्दनम् |
अयम् आख्याति ते राम सेवकः मन्त्रि सत्तमः
हनुमान् यन् निमित्तम् त्वम् निर्जनम् वनम् आगतः |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वसतः च वने तव
रक्षसा अपहृता भार्या मैथिली जनक आत्मजा |
त्वया वियुक्ता रुदती लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता
verses.iast:
punareva abravīt prītaḥ rāghavam raghunandanam |
ayam ākhyāti te rāma sevakaḥ mantri sattamaḥ
hanumān yan nimittam tvam nirjanam vanam āgataḥ |
lakśmaṇena saha bhrātrā vasataḥ ca vane tava
rakśasā apahṛtā bhāryā maithilī janaka ātmajā |
tvayā viyuktā rudatī lakśmaṇena ca dhīmatā
verses.translation: Then Sugreeva who is gladdened again spoke to Rama of Raghu's dynasty, "My best minister and this servant of yours Hanuma informed me of the reason for which you have come to uninhabited forests along with your brother Lakshmana, and that while living in the forest, and when you and this courageous Lakshmana are not her alongside a demon stole your wife Maithili, the daughter of Janaka, wailing as she was.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तरम् प्रेप्सुना तेन हत्वा गृध्रम् जटायुषम् |
भार्या वियोगजम् दुःखम् प्रापितः तेन रक्ष्सा
verses.iast:
antaram prepsunā tena hatvā gṛdhram jaṭāyuṣam |
bhāryā viyogajam duḥkham prāpitaḥ tena rakśsā
verses.translation: "And he also said about that arch demon's killing an eagle named Jatayu on waiting for an opportunity, and his causing an agony in you by way of separating your wife.

glosses.meaning: one named Jataayu, eagle, on killing

verses.devanagari:
भर्या वियोगजम् दुःखम् न चिरात् त्वम् विमोक्ष्यसे |
अहम् ताम् आनयिष्यामि नष्टाम् वेदश्रुतीम् इव
verses.iast:
bharyā viyogajam duḥkham na cirāt tvam vimokśyase |
aham tām ānayiṣyāmi naṣṭām vedaśrutīm iva
verses.translation: "Before long you will get rid off your agony caused by the separation of wife, for I will fetch her very soon, like the retrieval Vedic Scriptures.
notes: When four Veda-s were stolen by demons called Madhu and Kaitabha, Vishnu retrieved them, in his Fish incarnation. Again when demons called Somakaasura stole them Vishnu in the form of Hayagreeva, Horse-faced Divinity, retrieved them. Here it is suggested that Sugreeva is reminding Rama of his earlier incarnation like the fish and horse-faced Hayagriiva, and compares Seetha with the Veda-s, that cannot be humbled down or controlled, or stolen by any single being.

glosses.meaning: you, wife, caused by separation, agony

verses.devanagari:
रसातले वा वर्तन्तीम् वर्तन्तीम् वा नभः तले |
अहम् आनीय दास्यामि तव भार्याम् अरिन्दम
verses.iast:
rasātale vā vartantīm vartantīm vā nabhaḥ tale |
aham ānīya dāsyāmi tava bhāryām arindama
verses.translation: "Oh! Enemy destroyer, Rama, I will fetch your wife to give her to you whether she is in netherworlds or even in empyrean worlds.

glosses.meaning: in netherworlds, let her be abiding, either

verses.devanagari:
इदम् तथ्यम् मम वचः त्वम् अवेहि च राघव |
न शक्या सा जरयितुम् अपि सः इन्द्रैः सुर असुरैः
तव भार्या महाबाहो भक्ष्यम् विष कृतम् यथा |
verses.iast:
idam tathyam mama vacaḥ tvam avehi ca rāghava |
na śakyā sā jarayitum api saḥ indraiḥ sura asuraiḥ
tava bhāryā mahābāho bhakśyam viṣa kṛtam yathā |
verses.translation: "You may know that this word of mine is definite oh, Raghava. Your wife is as good as an indigestible foodstuff made with poison, indigestive even to Indra, put together with all gods and demons.

glosses.meaning: along with Indra, by gods, or by demons, even

verses.devanagari:
त्यज शोकम् महाबाहो ताम् कान्ताम् आनयामि ते |
अनुमानात् तु जानामि मैथिली सा न संशयः |
ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रक्षसा रौउद्र कर्मणा
क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम् |
स्फुरन्ती रावणस्य अन्के पन्नगेन्द्र वधूः यथा
verses.iast:
tyaja śokam mahābāho tām kāntām ānayāmi te |
anumānāt tu jānāmi maithilī sā na saṃśayaḥ |
hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rakśasā rauudra karmaṇā
krośantī rāma rāmeti lakśmaṇeti ca visvaram |
sphurantī rāvaṇasya anke pannagendra vadhūḥ yathā
verses.translation: "Give-up your lamentation, oh, great-shouldered one, for I will bring back that lady for you. And by inference I know her... undoubtedly I have seen Maithilee while that demon with cruel deeds was abducting her... then she was crying piteously calling 'Rama, Rama...' and also calling 'Lakshmana...' and she was writhing in the flanks of Ravana like the wife of serpent's lord...

glosses.meaning: your, lady, her, I will bring back

verses.devanagari:
आत्मना पञ्चमम् माम् हि दृष्ट्वा शैल तले स्थितम् |
उत्तरीयम् तया त्यक्तम् शुभानि आभरणानि च
verses.iast:
ātmanā pañcamam mām hi dṛṣṭvā śaila tale sthitam |
uttarīyam tayā tyak.htam śubhāni ābharaṇāni ca
verses.translation: "Myself being the fifth one on the cliff of the mountain, on seeing me she dropped the upper cloth of her sari along with auspicious jewellery.
notes: While there are four more besides Sugreeva on the cliff of the mountain, like Hanuma, Nala, Neela, and Taara, Seetha 'has seen' Sugreeva 'alone' and dropped the bundle of jewellery aiming at Sugreeva. It is said that Seetha has blessed Sugreeva by mercifully eying him, and thus his turmoil is going to alleviate at the grace of her divine look, for she is Goddess Lakshmi.

glosses.meaning: by her, her upper cloth, was dropped

verses.devanagari:
तानि अस्माभिः गृहीतानि निहितानि च राघव |
आनयिष्यामि अहम् तानि प्रत्यभिज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
tāni asmābhiḥ gṛhītāni nihitāni ca rāghava |
ānayiṣyāmi aham tāni pratyabhijñātum arhasi
verses.translation: "We took those jewellery items and stored them, Raaghava... I will get them and it will be apt of you to identify them..." thus said Sugreeva to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
तम् अब्रवीत् ततः रामः सुग्रीवम् प्रिय वादिनम् |
आनयस्व सखे शीघ्रम् किम् अर्थम् प्रविलम्बसे
verses.iast:
tam abravīt tataḥ rāmaḥ sugrīvam priya vādinam |
ānayasva sakhe śīghram kim artham pravilambase
verses.translation: Then Rama said to that pleasant talker Sugreeva, "Get them quickly, my friend, what for you are delaying."

glosses.meaning: to him, to that pleasant talker

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवः शैलस्य गहनाम् गुहाम् |
प्रविवेश ततः शीघ्रम् राघव प्रिय काम्यया
verses.iast:
evam uk.htaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ śailasya gahanām guhām |
praviveśa tataḥ śīghram rāghava priya kāmyayā
verses.translation: Thus said Sugreeva then entered the cavernous cave of that mountain quickly, to fulfil the yearning of Raghava.

verses.devanagari:
उत्तरीयम् गृहीत्वा तु स तानि आभरणानि च |
इदम् पश्य इति रामाय दर्शयामास वानरः
verses.iast:
uttarīyam gṛhītvā tu sa tāni ābharaṇāni ca |
idam paśya iti rāmāya darśayāmāsa vānaraḥ
verses.translation: On taking and bringing the parcel of that upper cloth with the auspicious jewellery, "This, you see..." saying thus that monkey started to show them to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
ततो गृहीत्वा वासः तु शुभानि आभरणानि च |
अभवत् बाष्प सम्रुद्धः नीहारेण इव चन्द्रमाः
verses.iast:
tato gṛhītvā vāsaḥ tu śubhāni ābharaṇāni ca |
abhavat bāṣpa sam.hruddhaḥ nīhāreṇa iva candramāḥ
verses.translation: Then on taking that cloth and also the auspicious jewellery, Rama became like mist filled moon with overfilling tears.

verses.devanagari:
सीता स्नेह प्रवृत्तेन स तु बाष्पेण दूषितः |
हा प्रिये इति रुदन् धैर्यम् उत्सृज्य न्यपतत् क्षितौ
verses.iast:
sītā sneha pravṛttena sa tu bāṣpeṇa dūṣitaḥ |
hā priye iti rudan dhairyam ut.hsṛjya nyapatat kśitau
verses.translation: But he who is blemished by tears that outpoured in all his friendship with Seetha, leaving off his courage fell on the ground wailing, 'oh, dear... oh, dear...'

verses.devanagari:
हृदि कृत्वा स बहुशः तम् अलंकारम् उत्तमम् |
निशश्वास भृशम् सर्पः बिलस्थ इव रोषितः
verses.iast:
hṛdi kṛtvā sa bahuśaḥ tam alaṃkāram uttamam |
niśaśvāsa bhṛśam sarpaḥ bilastha iva roṣitaḥ
verses.translation: The more he hugged those best decorative ornaments close to his heart, the more he hissed like a wrathful serpent in a snake pit.

glosses.meaning: wrathful, in snake pit, serpent, as with

verses.devanagari:
अविच्छिन्न अश्रु वेगः तु सौमित्रिम् प्रेक्ष्य पार्श्वतः |
परिदेवयितुम् दीनम् रामः सम् उपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
avicchinna aśru vegaḥ tu saumitrim prekśya pārśvataḥ |
paridevayitum dīnam rāmaḥ sam upacakrame
verses.translation: With the unending rush of tears he saw Lakshmana at his side and started to wail piteously.

glosses.meaning: un, ending, tears, with rush of

verses.devanagari:
पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्या संत्यक्तम् ह्रियमाणया |
उत्तरीयम् इदम् भूमौ शरीराद् भूषणानि च
verses.iast:
paśya lakśmaṇa vaidehyā santyak.htam hriyamāṇayā |
uttarīyam idam bhūmau śarīrād bhūṣaṇāni ca
verses.translation: "Lakshmana, see this upper cloth and these ornaments too of Vaidehi, shed from her body and dropped onto the ground while she is being abducted.

verses.devanagari:
शाद्वलिन्याम् ध्रुवम् भूम्याम् सीतया ह्रियमाणया |
उत्सृष्टम् भूषणाम् इदम् तथा रूपम् हि दृश्यते
verses.iast:
śādvalinyām dhruvam bhūmyām sītayā hriyamāṇayā |
ut.hsṛṣṭam bhūṣaṇām idam tathā rūpam hi dṛśyate
verses.translation: "Seetha must have definitely dropped these ornaments onto pastureland, for they appear to be in their original shape, indeed." So said Rama to Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तसः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् इदम् अब्रवीत् |
न अहम् जानामि केयूरे न अहम् जानामि कुण्डले
नूपुरे तु अभिजनामि नित्यम् पाद अभिवंदनात् |
verses.iast:
evam uktasaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakśmaṇo vākyam idam abravīt |
na aham jānāmi keyūre na aham jānāmi kuṇḍale
nūpure tu abhijanāmi nityam pāda abhivaṃdanāt |
verses.translation: When Rama thus said Lakshmana said this, "I know not the bracelets and I know not the earrings But because I always salute her feet I know these anklets well...
notes: This is a celebrated and controversial stanza. This is not found in ancient manuscripts or in Baroda version. Hanuma inspects the ornaments of Seetha in captivity in Sundara Kanda and a list is narrated there. But here, though no such listing is given, Lakshmana says he does not know the ornaments of upper body, but is aware of the anklets, for he always adores the feet of Seetha. The traditionalists attribute the kainkarya, the dedicated character to Lakshmana, and establish this verse as a supreme characterization of Lakshmana. Lakshmana regards Seetha as one of his mother. The wife of an elder brother is just another mother.

glosses.meaning: always, to feet, because I salute

verses.devanagari:
ततः तु राघवो वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कम् देशम् ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया |
रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण मम प्राणप्रिया प्रिया
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu rāghavo vākyam sugrīvam idam abravīt
brūhi sugrīva kam deśam hriyantī lakśitā tvayā |
rakśasā raudrarūpeṇa mama prāṇapriyā priyā
verses.translation: " Then Rama sadly asked to Sugreeva, "tell me Sugreeva, towards which country that ferocious looking demon abducted my dear one dearest than my lives, as spotted by you...

glosses.meaning: than my, own life-like [more than my life,] dearer
towards which, country, while being abducted

verses.devanagari:
क्व वा वसति तत् रक्षज़ः महत् व्यसनदम् मम |
यन् निमित्तम् अहम् सर्वान् नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसान्
verses.iast:
kva vā vasati tat rakśaJḥ mahat vyasanadam mama |
yan nimittam aham sarvān nāśayiṣyāmi rākśasān
verses.translation: "For the sake of which demon I wish to eliminate whole of the demons, that troublemaker of mine, where does he live, either...

glosses.meaning: all, demons, I wish to eliminate
that, to me, great, woe, causer [troublemaker]

verses.devanagari:
हरता मैथिलीम् येन माम् च रोषयता ध्रुवम् |
आत्मनो जीवित अन्ताय मृत्यु द्वारम् अपावृतम्
verses.iast:
haratā maithilīm yena mām ca roṣayatā dhruvam |
ātmano jīvita antāya mṛtyu dvāram apāvṛtam
verses.translation: "By whom Maithili is abducted and thus caused indignation in me, he has opened up the doors of his death suicidally.

verses.devanagari:
मम दयित तमा हृता वनात् रजनिचरेण विमथ्य येन सा |
कथय मम रिपुम् तम् अद्य वै प्लवगपते यम सन्निधिम् नयामि
verses.iast:
mama dayita tamā hṛtā vanāt rajanicareṇa vimathya yena sā |
kathaya mama ripum tam adya vai plavagapate yama sannidhim nayāmi
verses.translation: " Oh, king of the fly-jumpers, tell me which demon forcibly stole her, my dearest one than all, by molesting her in the forest, tell me about that enemy of mine, for sure I will lead him to the fore of Death today itself...

glosses.meaning: of my, enemy, about him, you tell
